patterns.what_worked: Red-first pins written against the fixture's own call counters (clock reads, per-texture deco writes, fill writes) before any fix: 20/1305 failed exactly as intended, then green. Each of the four optimizations has a mutation that re-introduces the removed work and kills only its own pins (M1 10 fails, M2 2, M3 4, M4 4, M4b 4) on fresh /tmp source copies. A3 used the dispatch's permitted restructure variant (single fill write at the end, no dirty flag), which kept the 2026-10-28 correctness pins 12c2/12c3 untouched and green.
